ruleDefinitions.name: Local Accounts Discovery
ruleDefinitions.description: Local accounts, System Owner/User discovery using operating systems utilities

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/c.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*dir\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Users\\\\.*"))) AND  NOT (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ rmdir\\ .*"))) OR (((process_path = RGX("\\\\net\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\net1\\\.exe$")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*user.*")) AND  NOT ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/domain.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/add.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/delete.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/active.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/expires.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/passwordreq.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/scriptpath.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/times.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/workstations.*")))) OR ((process_path = RGX("\\\\whoami\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\quser\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\qwinsta\\\.exe$")) OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\wmic\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*useraccount.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*get.*"))) OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\cmdkey\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/l.*")))
